overview: TravelSuite ERP includes a travel CRM built into your booking system, not bolted on beside it. Every customer profile keeps passports, family members, travel history, bookings, payments and conversations together, so any staff member can pick up any customer and know exactly where things stand.

Leads from your website, WhatsApp, Facebook, phone calls and walk-ins enter one pipeline. Each lead shows its source, the assigned staff member and the next follow-up, and reminders make sure no inquiry is forgotten between the first message and a confirmed booking.

faqs: What is a travel CRM and why does my agency need one?

A travel CRM keeps every lead, customer, booking and conversation in one place. Instead of inquiries scattered across WhatsApp, phone notes and spreadsheets, your team sees each traveller's full history, knows who is following up and never loses a lead that could have become a booking.
Where do leads come from?

Leads can be created from your website forms, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, phone calls, referrals, agents and walk-in customers. Each lead records its source, so the CRM reports show which channels bring the most inquiries and the most bookings.
How do I track a lead from inquiry to booking?

Every lead moves through clear stages: New, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal Sent, Negotiation, Converted or Lost. Work in a list or drag leads across a Kanban board, add tags such as VIP, Corporate or Hot Lead, and set a priority from Medium to Urgent.
Can I assign leads to my sales staff?
Yes. Each lead and customer has an assigned staff member, and staff see the leads they own. Managers can filter by owner, status or source to check workloads and make sure no inquiry is left waiting.
How do follow-up reminders work?

Schedule a follow-up as a call, meeting or message with a date, time and purpose. The CRM reminds the assigned person in advance, for example one hour before by notification and email, and the dashboard highlights today's and overdue follow-ups.
Is there a calendar view?
Yes. The CRM calendar shows every follow-up and task by day, week or month, so your team can plan calls around busy seasons like Umrah or school holidays.
Can I keep notes and documents on a customer?
Yes. Add notes to any lead or customer and upload documents such as passport copies, visa forms or quotations. Everything stays on the customer's record, so the next staff member has the full story.
Is the CRM connected to bookings and accounts?

Yes. The CRM shares one database with sales, bookings and finance. A lead converts into a quotation and a booking without retyping, and the customer list shows the last service, number of bookings and any amount still due.
What reports does the CRM include?

The CRM dashboard and reports show total, new, converted and lost leads, a lead status overview, lead source analytics with conversion rates, lead trends over time, and today's and overdue follow-ups.
Can I import my existing customers and leads?
Yes. Import customers and leads from Excel or CSV, and export them whenever you need. Our team can also help move your existing data during setup.
Can I send offers to customer groups?
Yes. Segment customers by destination, service, spend or travel history and send targeted offers, for example to Umrah customers before the season or families before school holidays.

Can I assign quotations to staff?

Offers start as drafts, wait to be sent, wait for the customer's decision and end as won or converted. Summary cards count each group.

Use Receive Payment to record a payment against an invoice with its method, such as cash, bank transfer or cheque. The invoice status updates to partial or paid automatically.

The cash basis uses only money actually received and paid. The accrual basis also includes amounts that are invoiced or approved but still due.

overview: Document Intelligence adds passport and travel document OCR to TravelSuite ERP. From a Visa, Hotel, Tour or CRM form, staff click Scan and add the document. The system reads the text, proposes values for the matching fields and waits for a person to check them, so data entry becomes a quick review instead of typing.

It recognises passports, national ID cards, driving licenses and generic documents. The engine available today is Tesseract, running on your own server, with language codes such as eng, ben or eng+ben for English, Bangla or both. Google Vision, Azure AI Vision, AWS Textract and custom providers are listed in settings as coming soon.

You decide how strict the process is. Settings let you switch OCR on or off everywhere, set a confidence threshold, require manual review before fields are applied, turn auto-fill on or off, and choose whether to store the raw OCR text and the OCR logs. The same rules apply in every module that uses scanning.

Every scan is recorded. The dashboard shows total, completed, reviewed and failed scans and a breakdown by module. Scan history lists the module, document type, reference, status, confidence and time, with the parsed and the staff-reviewed result side by side, while OCR logs show the error behind any failed attempt.
faqs: What does Document Intelligence do?
It reads text from travel documents with OCR and proposes values for the matching form fields, so staff review and apply instead of typing.
Which documents can it read?
Passports, national ID cards (NID), driving licenses and a generic type for other documents.
Which modules use it?
Visa, Hotel, Tour and CRM. The dashboard shows how many scans each module made.
Which OCR engine is used?
Tesseract, self-hosted on your server. Google Vision, Azure AI Vision, AWS Textract and custom providers appear in settings as coming soon and are not available yet.
Does it read Bangla?
Yes. Tesseract language codes such as eng, ben or eng+ben let you read English, Bangla or both.
Do staff have to check the result?
If Manual Review Required is on, staff must review and edit the extracted fields before they apply to the form. Auto-fill then fills the fields once the scan is reviewed and applied.
How accurate is it?
Accuracy depends on image quality and the document. Each scan records a confidence score, you set the confidence threshold, and staff review keeps mistakes out of your records.
Can I see past scans and errors?
Yes. Scan history shows every scan with status, confidence and the parsed vs. reviewed result, and OCR logs show the error for any failed scan. Both filter by module, document type and status.
